inline_prompts: Takahashi aggregated usage records from ticket gates. However, he accidentally erased some records of entering and exiting stations. He is trying to restore the erased records. You are given a string S consisting of i and o. This question addresses a different ambiguity not covered in the reference. We want to insert zero or more characters at arbitrary positions in S so that the resulting string satisfies the following conditions: - Every odd-numbered (1st, 3rd, ...) character is i while every even-numbered (2nd, 4th, ...) character is o. Find the number of characters that need to be inserted. It can be proved under the constraints of this problem that by inserting an appropriate finite number of characters, S can be made to satisfy the conditions. Input The input is given from Standard Input in the following format: S Output Print the answer. Constraints - S is a string of length between 1 and 100, consisting of i and o.
